attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Core shape table caching/locking mechanism used on every request across all tenants is reworked to use ILocalLock and cache Task<ShapeTable> instead of ShapeTable, so any bug (e.g., a faulted task getting cached, deadlock in ILocalLock, or DI resolution failure for ILocalLock in consuming modules) could break rendering tenant-wide, warranting careful review despite tests being updated."}

reason: Core shape table caching/locking mechanism used on every request across all tenants is reworked to use ILocalLock and cache Task<ShapeTable> instead of ShapeTable, so any bug (e.g., a faulted task getting cached, deadlock in ILocalLock, or DI resolution failure for ILocalLock in consuming modules) could break rendering tenant-wide, warranting careful review despite tests being updated.
